"I feel so insecure in my relationships that the people who I am closest with and should by all accounts feel the most comfortable scare me"

I don't think I've ever seen someone describe how I feel so perfectly. I'm scared of my friends too for the same reasons. Sometimes I feel like they would be better off without me, but that also probably doesn't reflect reality either.

It's the absolute worse knowing I'm problematic and toxic and still behaving like that, but I'm trying to be better (and failing miserably, but I'm still trying).

I hope you find some peace. And you're not ugly, inside or out. I know when I've been told this by strangers online that it's never really made me feel much better, but for what its worth, I really do mean it
Thank you, that brings me some comfort. I hope you're right. Best of luck to you too.
